text:
maria: Quick heads-up — Catalyst Node EAP kickoff thread. want to lock NDA, telemetry, and bench targets before we ship boards.
kevin: NDA status? legal asked for a single clause change last week, did we get sign-off from their GC?
catalyst-eng: their GC agreed to the minimal change yesterday. draft attached in my email, ok to proceed on our side. will upload signed copy to the shared drive by EOD.
anika: for telemetry we need a minimal set: timestamp, model_id, seq_len, token_count, p50/p95 latency, gpu_util, batch_size, and an anonymized request hash. can we get Catalyst to expose Prometheus or plaintext logs? :thinking_face:
catalyst-eng: Prometheus exporter is available on the test firmware. we can enable a prometheus endpoint on port 9100 for lab access. fine to share metrics with the redwood team under the NDA.
samir: benchmark targets proposal: p50 < 35ms for 2k tokens on redwood-13b-quant, throughput >= 30 seq/s at batch=8. these are our current internal baselines — want Catalyst to hit within 20% for EAP.
kevin: sounds reasonable. add a simple perf harness so we can reproduce runs. something like:
```
# run locally against lab box
run_bench --host 10.10.0.45 --model redwood-13b --precision int4 --batch 8 --length 2048 --iters 20
```
maria: +1 to the harness. anika, can you drop a json schema for telemetry we can share in the repo?
anika: will do. json schema will include field names, types, and allowed anonymization for request content. will post PR to the catalyst-eap repo by tomorrow.
catalyst-eng: we also need a shipping window — we can docket 6 dev kits next week. earliest lab arrival weds 09:00 PST if shipping monday.
samir: please include SFP details and power draw numbers in the packing list. we need to validate thermal telemetry during soak.
kevin: question on joint announcement: Catalyst asked to co-release a short blog if the EAP metrics are green. legal requires mutual approval and a 2-week embargo after first public post.
maria: create a small cadence: 2-week soak -> perf recap -> decide go/no-go on co-release. market can draft a joint post template but don't publish without sign-offs. @catalyst-eng is that acceptable?
catalyst-eng: that's fine. prefer to hold announcement until we confirm reproducible benchmarks and telemetry pipeline is ingesting correctly. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Catalyst EAP sync — Wed 09:30 PST. Invite sent to participants.
maria: action items: (1) kevin confirm NDA upload, (2) anika PR telemetry schema, (3) samir share harness + target numbers in repo, (4) catalyst-eng ship 6 dev kits and enable prometheus endpoint. I’ll own go/no-go cadence.
kevin: I’ll follow up with legal and post signed NDA link here when done.
anika: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/catalyst-eap/telemetry-schema pr#12
samir: added perf harness script and README to repo, see run_in_lab.sh
maria: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for EAP logistics. ping me for any blockers. :rocket:
